Screenshot recognition descriptors

The index contains artwork and card-face descriptors for 521 card IDs across the supported fixed versions.
It contains no rankings, tier labels, user screenshots or personal file paths.
Recognition and tier-label OCR run in browser Workers. Screenshots are not uploaded.
Low-resolution, cropped, overlapping or ambiguous cards require manual review.
Game artwork and text belong to Mega Crit and their respective rights holders.
